sources.title: Armenia Migration and Citizenship Service: passport for a citizen aged 16 or over
sources.publisher: Migration and Citizenship Service, Ministry of Internal Affairs of Armenia
sources.officialityEvidence: Armenia's current Ministry of Internal Affairs service identifies the RA citizen passport as a document of identity and citizenship used for leaving and returning to Armenia; the Service has a separately described special-passport route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The passport is a document certifying the person's identity and citizenship ... for leaving and returning to Armenia.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document makes F5A tourism available to citizens of all countries and provides electronic delivery of the visa certificate.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: online visa is operational
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office
sources.officialityEvidence: The institutional Government page identifies equatorialguinea-evisa.com as the operational visa site and says interested visitors can obtain a visa online without attending in person.
sources.supportingExcerpt: todos los interesados en viajar al país podrán conseguir su visado sin tener que desplazarse físicamente.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live eligibility and electronic delivery translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government-authenticated exact domain currently serves its live Angular English translation asset. It states that all nationalities can apply and that eVisas are emailed and downloadable as PDF.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E- Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live regular-passport translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government-authenticated exact domain's live English asset limits the eVisa application to the regular passport used for travel and excludes other travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The only travel document that can be used ... is your regular passport.

policies.title: Armenian ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service accepts citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Use the RA citizen passport, which Armenia's Migration and Citizenship Service identifies as the travel document for leaving and returning to Armenia. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days, with the stated passport-validity and supporting-document requirements.
Apply online, upload documents and pay. The emailed visa certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. Its current all-country document does not identify an Armenian ordinary-passport exception; this classification is medium confidence. Work, residence, special documents, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the RA citizen passport and required tourism documents.
Pay and obtain the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the certificate and required documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Armenian ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's institutional Government page authenticates its online visa service; the live translation asset on that exact domain accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email/PDF.
conditions: Apply using the regular Armenian citizen passport that will be used for travel; the live official translation asset excludes non-regular travel documents.
Register, upload the required visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not an ETA or visa on arrival.
Purpose, passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register and submit the visitor eVisa application with the Armenian ordinary passport to be used for travel.
Pay online and receive the issued eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
Carry the issued record and meet entry-point and final-admission conditions.
